description: COMBINE the current best (brief 21 HEAD 250a694c, 4394us) with brief 16's n=352 tuning win (01c41008): brief 16 cut n=352 B=40 from 1617us to 1529us (~5.3% shape, ~0.5% geomean) by widening the n=352 blocked-panel cb 16->32 (halves 22->11 panel/trailing launches) and panel CTA threads 128->256 (shortens the tall per-column reductions). The current best's n=352 path is a SEPARATE qr_panel<16> blocked kernel untouched by the panel-port/n=4096 combines, so brief 16's cb=32/threads=256 tuning transfers cleanly and is orthogonal to the n>=512 work. Apply brief 16's n=352 parameters onto the best; keep all other n exactly as the best. FP32. Re-measure min-of-3 (bimodal). Avoid the substring 'stream' anywhere incl. comments.

Applied brief 16's n=352 panel optimum (cb 16->32, panel CTA threads 128->256) onto parent A's separate blocked qr_panel path; orthogonal to the panel-port/n=4096 combines (which did NOT touch n=352). 3 surgical edits, all other n byte-identical: (1) panel_factor host wrapper adds a 256-thread dispatch launching panel_factor_kernel<256>; (2) new _NB_352=32/_PANEL_THREADS_352=256 constants; (3) n=352 return uses them instead of _nb_for(352)=16/_panel_threads_for(352)=128. cb=32 halves panel count 22->11 (half panel + cuBLAS trailing launches); 256-thread CTA (8 warps) shortens tall per-column reductions over m<=352 + hides serial-recurrence barrier latency. FP32 throughout. Validate PASS + all 3 guards CLEAN (n=351 off-grid scaled_factor_residual 0.0169). Benchmark min-of-3 = 4366.93us (runs 4366.93/4372.75/4371.53, tight, no bimodality) vs parent A 4394.12 = 1.0062x. n=352 shape2 1424.2us steady across all 3 (1424.2/1425.0/1425.1) vs parent A's ~1617us on this shape (-12pct). n=512 group clean (~7845/8817us). nsys: panel_factor_kernel<256> = 84.5pct GPU (143 inst = ~11 panels x 13 replicas), cuBLAS SIMT SGEMM trailing, latency-bound panel as expected at B=40.

n=352 cb sweep: cb=24 (threads=256). _NB_352 32->24 only; threads=256 and all other n unchanged. Validate PASS + 3 guards CLEAN. Benchmark min-of-3 = 4375.43us (4393.79/4378.10/4375.43); n=352 shape2 ~1434us. REGRESSION vs trial-1 cb=32 (4366.93us / n352 1424us) -> cb=24 worse than cb=32. Confirms parent B's cb=32 optimum holds on parent A's base (cb=32 halves panel count to 11 vs 15 at cb=24).

n=352 threads sweep: threads=384 (cb=32). Added panel_factor_kernel<384> + a 384-thread dispatch tier; _PANEL_THREADS_352 256->384; all other n unchanged. Validate PASS + 3 guards CLEAN. CONTENTION-POLLUTED: fleet fully saturated (both B200 ~100pct, 7 eval procs), every read landed in the bimodal slow mode -- n=512 sentinel shape3 ~17.7k vs clean ~7.85k = ~2.25x UNIFORM inflation across ALL shapes (contention, NOT a threads=384 regression). Min-of-5 geomean = 9172.66us (9172.66/9175.74/9175.79/9183.05/13377.92), NOT comparable to trial-1 clean 4366.93us. Contention-invariant per-shape signal: n=352/shape3 ratio 3094/17674=0.1751 (threads=384) vs trial-1 clean 1424/7847=0.1815 (threads=256) => threads=384 ~= 256 within noise floor (~0.1pct geomean effect). threads=256 remains the brief optimum. NEEDS clean-window re-read.

Reverted trial-3's unused <384> template+tier so the final diff is the minimal clean transfer vs parent A (28+/5-), functionally byte-identical to trial 1 (only 2 comment lines differ). OPEN directions for the manager: (1) cb=40/48 needs MAXCB raised from 32 (the red[MAXCB*16]/wsh[MAXCB] SMEM buffers hard-cap cb at 32) -- a small structural change that could halve panels again to ~8-9, untested here because it exceeds the safe knob envelope; (2) the n=352 panel is the SAME single-CTA-per-matrix latency-bound kernel (B=40 CTAs, 0.07 waves/SM, 95pct idle GPU) that the n=4096 cooperative-CLUSTER panel was built for -- routing n=352 through a K-CTA cluster panel (split the m=352 rows across idle SMs) is a structural lever this combine did not touch and could attack the real bottleneck rather than the panel-count knob; (3) a clean-window re-read of threads=384 would settle whether the ~0.1pct hint is real. n=352 is only ~3pct of the geomean so further n=352 work has a small ceiling -- the big movers remain the n=512 B=640 and n=1024 B=60 groups.
